In addition to ongoing price drops on the AirPods Pro 3 and the all-new AirTag 2 hitting a fresh low at $20 each, preorders for the brand new M6 Mac mini are now back in stock at Amazon, and we've also rounded up some notable trade-in deals worth a look below. Amazon is also carrying up to $290 off top-tier Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models, as well as deals on one of my all-time favorite chargers—the Anker Prime display power bank that doubles as a wall charger. More on all of that and more below.

One of the best Apple deals of the year: all-new 2026 AirTag 2 from just $20 each

  • AirTag 2 $24 (regularly $29) — new all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (regularly $99) — new all-time low
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (regularly $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (regularly $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regularly $129)

All-new M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini preorders are now back in stock at Amazon

Apple today unveiled and opened preorders for the upgraded M6 Mac mini alongside the M5 Pro version, and preorders are now also live over at Amazon. And don't forget to grab that new-generation Apple Polishing Cloth for $9 while you can—before it's sold out.

Apple today unveiled its first Mac powered by the all-new M6 chip, alongside an upgraded M5 Pro Mac mini—both now up for preorder at Amazon:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

After the previous-generation M4 lineup was essentially sold out at retail for months, the all-new M6 and M5 Pro models are now fully stocked at Amazon, though whether Apple can keep up with demand remains to be seen (they clearly couldn't keep up when the Neo launched).

Best Buy takes up to $500 off M6 Mac mini with M4 trade-in, members earn 2x rewards

Apple's official Bumper case drops to a new all-time low at under $13 (68% off)

For those of you rocking an iPhone Air, Apple's official Bumper case has just dropped to a new all-time low at Amazon, with Prime members getting it shipped for under $13.

Amazon is currently selling Apple's official Bumper case for the iPhone Air, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35, priced as low as $12.64.

The sky blue colorway is under $13, marking an all-time low at Amazon—a whopping 68% off its $39 MSRP. Unfortunately, other colorways are priced higher, with black already completely sold out—at this price, the sky blue is likely to follow suit.

That's right, it's just a minimalist Bumper that wraps around the edges of the device, but it's a great price on an official Apple case. It lets you show off the phone's design while providing decent protection for those who just need the basics—though it only covers the edges, not the screen or camera module.

Just picked up a new Mac mini or Mac Studio? Here are the displays that pair perfectly

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models are $220 off today (matching Prime Day pricing)

While Apple's official certified refurbished store is my top recommendation for scoring deals on iPhones, Apple isn't yet selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there—that likely won't happen until after the 18 series launches next month. Meanwhile, Amazon's best Premium Renewed stock has returned to Prime Day pricing, saving you up to $220 off new models.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed models have long been the best way to get an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Beyond saving hundreds of dollars, you also get a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty and a guarantee of "greater than 90% original battery capacity"—other non-"Premium" refurbished or used models on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and no comparable battery status assurance.

The 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back in stock today with up to $220 off—and the 512GB version is actually $20 cheaper than what I previously mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (regularly $1,499) — new all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (regularly $1,499) — new all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,208 (regularly $1,499) — new all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,166 (regularly $1,299) — new all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (regularly $1,299) — new all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (regularly $1,299) — new all-time low

Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger: my favorite portable charger drops to $70

Anker and other brands offer plenty of higher-wattage (or higher-capacity) power banks, but this 9,600mAh Anker Prime is my personal go-to. Now marked down to $70, it not only features a built-in display but also has built-in prongs so it can double as a wall charger.

Anker's official Amazon store currently has the 9,600mAh Prime power bank marked down to $69.99 with free shipping.

Regularly $90, today's discounted price matches what I previously mentioned as the official Prime Day price in June—and it's also Amazon's lowest price of the year.

Again, there are higher-capacity power banks on the market, but this is the most practical one in my arsenal. It's significantly more compact than the high-capacity models, with enough juice to keep my phone and MacBook powered all day long, and most importantly, it has a feature few other brands offer: built-in prongs.

What this means is that thanks to the foldable prongs on the back, you don't need to carry a separate wall charger to recharge the power bank—just plug it straight into the wall outlet. It will simultaneously charge your devices and the internal battery.

Beyond that, you'll also find a pair of USB-C ports and Anker's built-in 1.3-inch smart display:

It comes with a two-year warranty, a USB-C cable (100W, braided), and a travel pouch included.

Anker 7-in-1 Nano charging station with retractable USB-C and smart display drops to $60 (25% off)

Anker MagSafe power bank from $36 this week with free shipping (multiple colors available)

Tim Cook cements his legacy with a new-generation Apple Polishing Cloth, on sale for $9

Twelve South TimePorter Apple Watch band organizer drops to a year-round low of $21 with Prime shipping

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card with iOS or Android support hits a new Amazon all-time low at $25

Anker recently launched a new SmartTrack Find My Card wallet card—the first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub—and it's now marked down to a new all-time low of $25 with Prime shipping at Amazon.

Anker's official EufyHome Amazon store currently has the new SmartTrack Card E40 priced at $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35, compatible with both iOS and Android.

It first hit Amazon at $35 last month, then saw a modest $5 discount, and now it's getting its first major price cut, setting a new Amazon low.

Effectively nearly 30% off, putting it on par with some of the better deals on similar wallet tracking cards this year.

I'm personally a huge fan of the Nomad Tracking Card—starting at $35 for the base version, or $45 for the Pro version with 16 months of battery life (after which it needs recharging)—but regardless of which one you choose, I think everyone should have one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave the house without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 packs all the most important features, including wireless charging, while being compatible with both Apple Find My and Google Find Hub. At just 1.7mm thick, it can ring at up to 80 decibels, making it easy to locate when nearby—and of course, you can also check its location on the map via the Find My and Find Hub apps.
